CREATE TABLE dbo.rv_a(id INT PRIMARY KEY, v INT, rv ROWVERSION)
CREATE TABLE dbo.rv_b(id INT PRIMARY KEY, rv TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE dbo.rv_nullable(id INT PRIMARY KEY, rv ROWVERSION NULL)
CREATE TABLE dbo.rv_legacy(id INT PRIMARY KEY, timestamp)

SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS table_name,c.name,t.name AS type_name,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.rv_a'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.rv_b'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.rv_nullable'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.rv_legacy')) ORDER BY table_name,c.column_id
SELECT @@DBTS AS dbts
